ui.siteDescription: A real-time community for curious builders.
ui.samplePostAccessibility: After 6 weekends of tiny commits, our open-source accessibility audit tool is finally live. It catches keyboard traps, contrast gaps, and missing labels right in your pull request. The best bit: our first issue was fixed by someone I met here last month.
ui.samplePostPerformance: A small thing that made our React app feel much faster: move expensive filtering to the server, but keep the search input instant with deferred rendering. Perceived performance is a feature.
ui.samplePostRust: Week 3 of learning Rust: ownership finally clicked when I stopped thinking of variables as boxes and started thinking about who gets to use a value, and when. What was your aha moment?
